full_name: Kamal Aljafari | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2009–2010 Arts Benjamin White Whitney Scholar and Radcliffe-Harvard Film Study Center Fellow Independent Artist (Israel)
bio: Kamal Aljafari is a filmmaker and visual artist who graduated from the Kunsthochschule für Medien (Academy of Media Arts) in Cologne, Germany.
